description: He wears a long dark green-gray crossed-front coat with gold geometric woven borders at the collar, front opening, cuffs and hem. Restrained curling embroidery ornaments the upper sleeves and lower coat. An ivory collar and fitted blue-gray inner sleeves show under the wider outer sleeves. A red-brown patterned sash and decorated dark belt wrap the waist, with round metal ornaments and two hanging tassels. Loose taupe trousers gather into tall brown leather boots with subtle gold-patterned upper sections. His head is uncovered. No armor or weapons are present.
